fixtures.scenario: A user deliberately chooses the restriction, precision, resource conversion, and structural problem-solving of a Commander identity outside WUBRG without collapsing it into artifacts, Eldrazi, Wastes, or generic mana.
Under pressure, the player accepts narrower tools, plans exact mana and sequencing, and turns asymmetry, utility lands, and durable engines into inevitability.
A player likes Eldrazi and artifact engines but has not said whether the center is the chosen strict Colorless restriction or access to all five colors.
Provenance should resolve the Colorless core identity chain.
Five-color access and unrestricted color expression are proposed as strict Colorless identity.
fixtures.expected: Reject Colorless unless the answer chooses the outside-WUBRG restriction rather than access to every color.
fixtures.boundary: Five-color Eldrazi or broad access remains WUBRG-side evidence.

fixtures.scenario: Order, duty, community, and White mana are proposed as Colorless.
fixtures.expected: Reject Colorless when White philosophy and colored mana are the center.
fixtures.boundary: Colorless restriction is not a substitute label for White structure.

fixtures.expected: Reject the conflation.

fixtures.expected: Reject artifact-only proof.
fixtures.boundary: Artifacts are a functional branch and may have colored identity.

fixtures.scenario: A prompt cites Eldrazi attraction alone as sufficient proof of Colorless identity.
fixtures.expected: Reject Eldrazi-only proof.
fixtures.boundary: Eldrazi are an internal branch and may appear outside strict Colorless decks.

fixtures.expected: Reject Wastes-only proof.
fixtures.boundary: Wastes and {C} are rules and display contexts, not public identity aliases.

fixtures.expected: Reject Devoid-only proof.
fixtures.boundary: Devoid does not erase colored Commander identity requirements.

fixtures.expected: Reject Phyrexia-only proof.

fixtures.scenario: A prompt treats five-color Eldrazi access as proof of strict Colorless identity.
fixtures.expected: Reject five-color Eldrazi proof.
fixtures.boundary: Five-color Eldrazi remains on the WUBRG side of the frozen collision.

fixtures.scenario: A prompt cites Commander product support or preview placement as semantic proof.
fixtures.expected: Reject support-only proof.
fixtures.boundary: Product, placement, and preview metadata do not create semantic authority or public expansion.

fixtures.scenario: A prompt treats Colorless as a sixth philosophical color parallel to WUBRG.
fixtures.expected: Reject the sixth-color model.
fixtures.boundary: Colorless is represented outside the five-color order, not appended to it.

fixtures.scenario: A public endpoint submits C as an identity alias.
fixtures.expected: Reject C as a public identity alias.
fixtures.boundary: C is a bounded mana and display code only; the accepted identity key remains COLORLESS.

fixtures.scenario: A public endpoint submits lowercase colorless as an identity alias.
fixtures.expected: Reject lowercase colorless as a public identity alias.
fixtures.boundary: Lowercase colorless remains a prose and query form; the accepted identity key remains COLORLESS.
